I found 6 YC companies from the 2022 and 2023 batches that are headquartered in France and currently have job openings. I used the YC Startup Directory filtered to Winter and Summer 2022, Winter and Summer 2023, HQ Region France, and "Is Hiring". All six are in Paris.

| Company | Batch | What they do |
|---|---|---|
| Osium AI | Summer 2023 | Speeds up materials innovation with AI |
| Rimward | Summer 2023 | Solar farm security software for existing cameras |
| Twenty | Summer 2023 | Open-source CRM |
| HyLight | Summer 2023 | Unmanned airships for inspecting critical assets |
| Escape | Winter 2023 | Offensive security for teams that are outnumbered |
| Windmill | Summer 2022 | Open-source platform that turns scripts into internal apps and workflows |

YC's own note says this list leaves out companies that were founded in France or by French founders but are headquartered elsewhere. I didn't open the individual job listings, so I haven't checked which roles are open.
